    <p class="eyebrow">Kabir Computational Molecular Science Lab</p>
    <h1>Kabir Lab</h1>
    <p class="tagline">Computing how molecular environments control light, reactivity, and recognition.</p>
    <p class="lead-copy">We combine quantum chemistry, molecular dynamics, QM/MM, and automated workflows to connect electronic structure with molecular behavior in proteins, solvents, and functional materials.</p>
    <p>Department of Chemistry and Forensic Science<br>Savannah State University</p>

<section class="band alt">
  <p class="section-kicker">Research identity</p>
  <h2>Molecular behavior is shaped by environment.</h2>
  <p class="lead-copy">Our work asks how electrostatics, hydrogen bonding, solvation, conformational sampling, and molecular architecture reshape excited states and intermolecular interactions. We develop reproducible computational workflows and apply them to flavins and fluorescent proteins, photoactive molecules, molecular association, and functional ionic materials.</p>
</section>

<section class="band">
  <p class="section-kicker">Research pillars</p>
  <h2>Three evidence-backed directions</h2>
  <div class="grid-3">
    <article class="card pillar-card">
      <div class="pillar-visual photophysics-visual" role="img" aria-label="Diagram of chromophore energy levels surrounded by electrostatic field contours."></div>
      <div>
        <span class="mini-label">Photophysics</span>
        <h3>How do environments tune molecular light?</h3>
        <p>How do local electrostatics, hydrogen bonding, redox and protonation state, protein structure, and molecular architecture control absorption, fluorescence, intersystem crossing, and charge-transfer pathways?</p>
        <p class="evidence-links"><a href="https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jpcb.4c03748">2024 methods paper</a> | <a href="https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jpcb.2c06475">2023 iLOV paper</a></p>
        <a href="research/photophysics/">Learn more</a>
      </div>
    </article>
    <article class="card pillar-card">
      <div class="pillar-visual workflow-visual" role="img" aria-label="Diagram connecting quantum chemistry, molecular dynamics, QM/MM, and analysis steps."></div>
      <div>
        <span class="mini-label">Workflows</span>
        <h3>How can simulations become reproducible evidence?</h3>
        <p>How can electronic structure, molecular dynamics, QM/MM, conformational sampling, explicit solvent, and analysis become reproducible enough for systematic comparison?</p>
        <p class="evidence-links"><a href="https://github.com/pabelkabir/QM-MM-Protocol-for-Flavoproteins">QM/MM protocol</a> | <a href="https://github.com/pabelkabir/Electrostatic-Spectral-Tuning-Maps">ESTM workflow</a></p>
        <a href="research/multiscale-workflows/">Learn more</a>
      </div>
    </article>
    <article class="card pillar-card">
      <div class="pillar-visual interaction-visual" role="img" aria-label="Diagram of three-dimensional interaction regions around a molecular surface."></div>
      <div>
        <span class="mini-label">Interactions</span>
        <h3>Where do molecules prefer to associate?</h3>
        <p>Where do molecules preferentially interact, how strong are those associations in a given environment, and how can that information guide molecular or materials design?</p>
        <p class="evidence-links"><a href="https://github.com/pabelkabir/Ab-Initio-Interaction-Map">AIIM repository</a> | <a href="https://doi.org/10.1007/s10904-017-0561-5">2017 binding paper</a></p>
        <a href="research/interactions-materials/">Learn more</a>
      </div>
    </article>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="band dark">
  <p class="section-kicker">Featured publications</p>
  <h2>Representative outputs</h2>
  <div class="publication-grid">
    <article class="publication-card">
      <span class="mini-label">2025</span>
      <h3>Stimulus-driven multipathway emission in 9-fluorenone derivatives</h3>
      <p class="pub-meta">Datta, Saptarshi; <strong>Kabir, Mohammad Pabel</strong>; Maliha, Sunjida Reza; Liu, Fang; Xu, Jinjia</p>
      <p class="pub-meta">ACS Applied Energy Materials, 2025</p>
      <p>Combines molecular design, spectroscopy, and excited-state calculations to explain how structure and environment redistribute fluorescence, charge-transfer emission, phosphorescence, and delayed fluorescence pathways.</p>
      <a href="https://doi.org/10.1021/acsaem.5c00577">DOI</a>
    </article>
    <article class="publication-card">
      <span class="mini-label">2024</span>
      <h3>Electronic-structure methods for flavin spectroscopy and photophysics</h3>
      <p class="pub-meta"><strong>Kabir, Mohammad Pabel</strong>; Ghosh, Paulami; Gozem, Samer</p>
      <p class="pub-meta">The Journal of Physical Chemistry B, 2024</p>
      <p>Benchmarks multireference, TD-DFT, coupled-cluster-related, and other methods to clarify which computational choices are reliable for flavin excited states.</p>
      <a href="https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jpcb.4c03748">DOI</a>
    </article>
    <article class="publication-card">
      <span class="mini-label">2023</span>
      <h3>Alternative strategy for spectral tuning of flavin-binding fluorescent proteins</h3>
      <p class="pub-meta"><strong>Kabir, Mohammad Pabel</strong>; Ouedraogo, Daniel; Orozco-Gonzalez, Yoelvis; Gadda, Giovanni; Gozem, Samer</p>
      <p class="pub-meta">The Journal of Physical Chemistry B, 2023</p>
      <p>Uses electrostatic maps, simulations, QM/MM calculations, mutagenesis, and spectroscopy to test a rational strategy for shifting flavoprotein fluorescence.</p>
      <a href="https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jpcb.2c06475">DOI</a>
    </article>
  </div>

<section class="band">
  <p class="section-kicker">Open research</p>
  <h2>Reusable workflows and public resources</h2>
  <div class="software-grid">
    <article class="software-card">

      <h3>Ab-Initio Interaction Map</h3>
      <p>Workflow for generating three-dimensional interaction maps between molecular partners from structural inputs.</p>
      <a href="https://github.com/pabelkabir/Ab-Initio-Interaction-Map">Repository</a>
    </article>
    <article class="software-card">
      <span class="tag">legacy protocol</span>
      <h3>Electrostatic Spectral Tuning Maps</h3>
      <p>Protocol for mapping how electrostatic environments tune molecular spectral features.</p>
      <a href="https://github.com/pabelkabir/Electrostatic-Spectral-Tuning-Maps">Repository</a>
    </article>
    <article class="software-card">
      <span class="tag">research workflow</span>
      <h3>QM/MM Protocol for Flavoproteins</h3>
      <p>Research workflow for APEC-style QM/MM modeling of flavoprotein environments.</p>
      <a href="https://github.com/pabelkabir/QM-MM-Protocol-for-Flavoproteins">Repository</a>
    </article>
    <article class="software-card">
      <span class="tag">collaborative contribution</span>
      <h3>AutoSolvate contribution</h3>
      <p>Fork of a Liu Group project for explicit-solvent quantum chemistry setup, shown here as a related contribution rather than a sole Kabir Lab product.</p>
      <a href="https://github.com/pabelkabir/AutoSolvate">Repository</a>
    </article>
  </div>
</section>
